subject: Leadership recap: business outcomes, risks, and procurement path for StellarHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@stellarhealth.com>, Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership recap: business outcomes, risks, and procurement path for StellarHealth

Tom / Dana — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side so we have alignment going into the sponsor touchpoint next week. I’ve summarized the business outcomes, primary risks, and the suggested procurement path below.

What we heard (pain points)
- Latency spikes on peak hours causing slow patient-facing flows (~400–700ms tail latency).
- Per-token inference cost running above internal targets; they expect a ~35–45% reduction to justify broad rollout.
- Compliance: need SOC 2 evidence and clarity on data residency / egress for PHI-adjacent telemetry.

Desired outcomes (metrics the sponsor will care about)
- P95 request latency <150ms for the targeted endpoint (in-prod SLA).
- Unit inference cost <= 60% of current spend for comparison workload.
- SOC 2 snapshot + data-handling appendix accepted by their security/compliance team.

Our proposed path (high level)
1) 6-week pilot on Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) focused on the 2 high-volume endpoints (inference-only).
2) Enable KV prefix caching and sequence-aware batching configuration we discussed — target 30–45% cost reduction.
3) Security evidence: attach SOC 2 snapshot and a proposed data-handling appendix for residency controls.
4) Procurement: pricing matrix attached; ask for purchase order or commitment to pilot by Aug 10 to hit Q3 onboarding goals.

Open risks & mitigations
- Data residency/egress: Kimberly (cc’d) to own the data appendix and confirm region options (US West, US East).
- SLA exceptions: if they require lower P95 than our standard tier, we’ll propose a short-term SLA credit and operational playbook during pilot.
- Budget timing: Ben (cc’d) recommended a scoped discount for strategic customers — he’ll propose the structure internally.

Next steps (requested owners & dates)
- Marissa: Send SOW (attached) + pricing matrix to Procurement; request PO by Aug 10.
- Tom / Sponsor: Confirm exec sponsor availability for a 30-minute briefing on Aug 5 (they requested morning PT).
- Kimberly: Draft data-handling appendix and SOC 2 evidence packet by Aug 3.
- Ben / Sales Ops: Provide discount framework and TPM allocation by Aug 4.

Attachments: SOW_StellarHealth_v1.pdf, SOC2_snapshot_2025.pdf, pricing-matrix-stellarhealth.xlsx

If I missed anything obvious or you want a different format for the sponsor slide, say the word — I can turn this into a one-pager for the exec meeting.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

--

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership recap: business outcomes, risks, and procurement path for StellarHealth

Marissa — good, clear notes. A couple quick operational asks: 

1) We should earmark a TPM (customer success engineering) for this pilot — the technical integration looks non-trivial and will affect the timeline. Can you confirm you want Connor to lead?
2) On commercial: given their strategic footprint in payer networks, propose a one-time pilot discount (25%) + performance-based ramp to full price. I’ll draft options and share by Aug 4.
3) If they insist on P95 <100ms, we should be prepared to offer an SLA credit (short-term) — that needs legal OK. Loop in Kimberly on that thread (she’s cc’d).

Also thinking ahead — map the pilot KPI dashboard we’ll show to the sponsor: latency P50/P95, tokens per second, cost-per-inference, and failover incidents. I’ll add that to the one-pager.

Ben
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Marissa / team — thanks for the detailed summary. That captures the conversation well. A few quick items from our side: 

- Exec sponsor is confirmed for Thu Aug 5 at 10:00 AM PT (we’ll send a calendar invite).
- Procurement asked for the SOW + a simple T&Cs summary to circulate internally — they’d like to see that alongside the pricing matrix.
- Clarification: for the pilot, do you support data residency in US-East (Virginia) or only US-West? We also need to confirm whether the telemetry we send is considered PHI under our policy (my legal will follow up separately).

We’re aligned on timeline — PO by Aug 10 is feasible if the SOW + T&Cs look standard. Looking forward to the sponsor briefing.

Tom Rivers

Tom — thanks, great to hear the sponsor briefing is set. Short replies below and one new attachment (data-handling-appendix-draft.docx).

- T&Cs & SOW: attached (see SOW_StellarHealth_v1.pdf + pricing matrix). I’ll also prepare a 1-page T&Cs summary to circulate to Procurement before EOD Aug 3.
- Data residency: we support both US-West (Oregon) and US-East (Virginia) for dedicated pools. Kimberly (cc’d) will add the explicit region option to the appendix and confirm whether any telemetry paths need additional controls.
- PHI telemetry: please have your legal/security send the list of fields they consider PHI; Kimberly will map each item to our handling mode and call out if we recommend encryption-at-rest/in-transit or redaction.

DocuSign: I’ve dropped a placeholder link for the SOW and will enable redlines once legal gives the green light: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-4723

Next immediate steps:
- Kimberly: finalize data-handling appendix and SOC 2 evidence packet by EOD Aug 3 (owner).
- Marissa: send 1-page T&Cs summary to procurement by EOD Aug 3 (owner).
- Ben / Sales Ops: finalize pilot discount proposal by Aug 4.

Thanks — see you on the sponsor call Thursday.
